new_destinations.name: Royal National Park
members: royal-national-park-3 Bundeena to Otford Coast Track
new_destinations.notes: Decided once here (the south-coast pass did not place any Royal NP stop): Royal National Park is a destination (every national park is), centred on the Audley hub (the park centroid -34.118,151.064 is LOW and is not used). Audley, Wedding Cake Rock and Bundeena lie inside Sydney's 30 km reach but are the park's own stops, so they are the park's spots, not Sydney's. Span 40 km covers all seven (max 14 km from Audley). The Royal Coast Track is the park's 26 km signature walk, so it is a spot, with North Era, Big Marley and Werrong beaches (rejected) and Figure Eight Pools (review) folded under it. The destination overlaps Sydney's span on its southern edge; the skeptic asked for this placement. If declined: Audley, Wedding Cake Rock and Bundeena could alternatively be Sydney spots (next free ids sydney-83..85); the rest stand alone.
